The '''Lucent Square''' was an area in the commercial zone of [[Promenade]] in the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-world]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It contained a giant [[Statue of Karagga the Unyielding|statue]] of [[Karagga]] the Unyielding in the center of it and was thriving with people during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3639 BBY]], the [[Chevin Conglomerate]] announced the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]] there, through the use of a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of considerable projection size, near the Hutt statue.<ref name="TOR" />
